title: Control Gardener: prep notes & evidence map (scratch)
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad for mapping controls to artifacts, questions for infra/product owners, and a running checklist for audit evidence. Working metaphor: think of each control as a garden bed — prune, document, and tag what grows there.

Top-level concerns (raw):
- Which of our existing monitoring alerts qualify as control evidence vs operational telemetry? (eg: disk-pressure alert -> evidence for availability control?)
- Evidence retention: some logs live 90d in ELK, but our policy says 180d for control C-Logging-03. Who owns the retention change?
- Private deployment edgecases: on-prem installs keep logs locally — need signed attestation + sample config.

Control quick-map (first pass):
- C-Auth-01: MFA for console + API keys rotation. Owner: infra-sre (Samir). Evidence candidates: IAM policy snapshots (GH-PR-4721), Okta org audit export (S3:/evidence/okta/okta-2026-01.zip), rotation runbook (confluence). Questions: do service accounts count if they use key rotation? (ask dev-platform).
- C-Config-02: Change control for prod infra. Owner: platform-engineering (Marta). Evidence: PR history with approvals, release notes, canary rollout logs. Gap: manual ticket references missing for some hotfixes (need to reconstruct).
- C-Logging-03: Aggregate logging retention + integrity. Owner: obs (Noah). Evidence: ELK retention policy screenshot, S3 access logs, example signed hash of archived bundle. Open: cross-region replication proof for archived logs.

Evidence collection TODOs (short):
- [ ] Export Okta org audit for Jan-Mar 2026 (Samir)
- [ ] Compile list of hotfix PRs lacking ticket refs (Marta)
- [ ] Run archive-hash script for 2025 logs and store checksum in evidence bucket (Noah)
- [ ] Draft attestation template for on-prem customer packages (me)

Unresolved questions / quick notes to ask reviewers:
- Do scoped service tokens used by infra pipelines require MFA-equivalent control or is rotation + constrained scope acceptable? (security policy lookup)
- For Dedicated customers, we promised isolation controls: do we need per-tenant network diagrams as evidence or is a general VPC config + routing table snapshot enough?
- Are synthetic canaries considered monitoring evidence for availability SLAs or separate operational telemetry?

Small sample artifacts to reference when I put into the evidence bucket:
- okta-export-2026-01.json.gz (S3:/evidence/okta/)...
- pr-approval-trail-2025-q4.csv (S3:/evidence/pr-trails/)...
- log-archive-2025-12.tar.gz + log-archive-2025-12.sha256

Caveats / heuristics I want to keep:
- Prefer snapshots (policy files, config exports, signed checksums) over ad-hoc logs that change frequently.
- If evidence requires combining multiple small artifacts (eg: PR + approval screenshot + deploy timing) create a single packed bundle with index.json pointing to sources.
- Keep one-line evidence descriptions in Confluence to speed auditor review; include contact person and timestamp.

Meeting notes (from catch-up 2026-02-08):
- Samir: working on Okta export automation (ETA 2 weeks).
- Marta: will draft retroactive ticket mapping, may need help from release-engineering to reconstruct timestamps.
- Noah: archiver script needs small tweak for S3 permissions (GH-PR-4721).

Next actions (this doc as my brain dump):
- Turn the control quick-map into a table and upload to /evidence/index-control-map-2026-03.csv
- Ping dev-platform about service account token policy and capture response in linked_artifacts (Jira key)
- Draft attestation for on-prem packages and run by legal for language.

Random snippets to save:
- "If it was not written down, it did not happen" -> aim to create tiny index files for each evidence bundle (md + pointers).
- Consider adding a "control gardener" label on evidence bucket objects so auditors can filter.

Notes-to-self: keep this doc light — it's a staging area. When items are mature, move them into shared_drives/security-and-compliance/evidence or confluence page SEC/Control-mapping-v2.

Links I referenced in meeting: confluence:SEC/Controls+Catalog+v2, jira:SEC-3121, PR:GH-PR-4721, slack:#trust-assurance (PM sync)

End of scratchpad.

(If I disappear: check /evidence/tmp/bundles for the packed artifacts; try running scripts/archiver with --dry-run first.)
